CRON.description: Set to '1' to enable daily maintenance via cron instead of systemd timer.

body_part_scan_size.description: Amount of data per email text/* mimepart, that will be run through body rules. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 50000).

bayes_auto_learn.description: Bayesian classifier auto-learning (default: 1). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1).

lock_method.description: Set file-locking method (flock is not safe over NFS, but is faster). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: flock).

normalize_charset.description: Whether to decode non- UTF-8 and non-ASCII textual parts and recode them to UTF-8 before the text is given over to rules processing. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1).

rawbody_part_scan_size.description: Amount of data per email text/* mimepart, that will be run through rawbody rules. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 500000).

report_contact.description: A 'contact address' users should contact for more info. (replaces _CONTACTADDRESS_ in the report template). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: youremailaddress@domain.tld).

report_safe.description: Save spam messages as a message/rfc822 MIME attachment instead of modifying the original message (0: off, 2: use text/plain instead). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1).

required_score.description: Set the threshold at which a message is considered spam (default: 5.0). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 5.0).

rewrite_header_subject.description: Add *****SPAM***** to the Subject header of spam e-mails. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: *****SPAM*****).

trusted_networks.description: Set which networks or hosts are considered 'trusted' by your mail server (i.e. not spammers). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 212.17.35.).

use_bayes.description: Use Bayesian classifier (default: 1). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 1).
